title: Connector pass-through.
officialText:
Chimney connectors shall not pass through any floor or ceiling, nor through a fire-resistance-
rated wall assembly. Chimney connectors for domestic-type appliances shall not pass through walls or partitions constructed of
combustible material to reach a masonry chimney unless:
1. The connector is labeled for wall pass-through and is installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions; or
2. The connector is put through a device labeled for wall pass-through; or
3. The connector has a diameter not larger than 10 inches (254 mm) and is installed in accordance with one of the methods
in Table 803.10.4. Concealed metal parts of the pass-through system in contact with flue gases shall be of stainless steel
or equivalent material that resists corrosion, softening or cracking up to 1,800°F (980°C).
